title: Russian Ship with 5,000 Tons of Wheat Docks in Astara
text:
Russian Ship with 5,000 Tons of Wheat Docks in Astara"

"🔆🔅Astara, Gilan province, September 9th - A Russian vessel carrying 5,000 tons of wheat has docked in Astara. The multi-purpose heavy vessel "Alpha Aquilon," one of the largest active ships in the Caspian Sea at 141 meters in length and 17 meters in width, sailing under the Russian flag, arrived at the Special Economic Zone and Port Complex of Astara in Gilan province with a cargo of 5,038 tons of wheat. "

"The shipment is being transferred directly to the complex's grain silos without interruption, utilizing a ship unloader (mechanical discharge system) with a capacity of 300 tons per hour.
